limitations: Development/regression suite, not an independent final benchmark; pending human label review.
Original source records and IDs are preserved exactly; detailed parser expectations are additional annotations.
Two inherited action hypotheses are ambiguous and are not required parser action classes; clarification or rejection is expected.
Semantic labels do not authorize execution or establish filesystem and approval facts.
The held_out split is a seeding exclusion; it does not establish independence from development decisions.
